newsitem.title: CANADA: Goldcorp sees high grades at Red Lake.
newsitem.headline: Goldcorp sees high grades at Red Lake.

text.p: Goldcorp Inc said on Wednesday that exploration at its Red Lake gold property in Northern Ontario suggests annual production in 1998 could exceed 150,000 ounces.
In February 1996, a 1998 annual production target of 150,000 ounces was based on an estimated head grade of 1.0 ounces per ton, Goldcorp said in a statement.
"Based on 1996 exploration success, targeted production in ounces should exceed this level," Goldcorp said.
Recent uncut assay results for 44 drill holes suggest the grade of the property's high grade zones should be "well above 1.0 ounces per ton," Goldcorp said.
The company also said a new high grade zone is developing to the east and continuing in depth.
And Goldcorp said "encouraging" structures are being found in the upper levels of the mine.
Goldcorp recently completed its takeover bid for Wharf Resources Ltd.
